# Key numbers (real data) - generated by scripts/key_numbers.py

- Dataset: 5,123 NSE daily files, 2006-01-02 to 2026-09-25, 3,949 securities (dead ones included).
- Split/bonus detector on held-out NSE records: precision 82%, recall 89%.

## Hypotheses

- H1: SUPPORTED - 12-1 momentum long-short earns a positive gross return (mean 2.09%/month, Newey-West t = 4.72)
- H2: SUPPORTED - Momentum top decile beats same-universe EW net of costs and taxes (test period) (+11.56 pp/yr, 95% CI [+4.27, +20.64])
- H3: SUPPORTED - The best grid variant beats EW after correcting for all variants tried (SPA p = 0.000, Reality Check p = 0.000 (12 variants))
- H4: SUPPORTED - Low-volatility decile has a higher Sharpe ratio than EW (gross) (Sharpe 1.00 vs 0.64; 95% CI of difference [0.12, 0.60])
- H5a: not supported - 1-month reversal long-short is profitable gross (mean -0.50%/month, t = -1.61)
- H5b: SUPPORTED - Reversal top decile does NOT beat EW net of costs (test period) (-10.54 pp/yr, 95% CI [-14.62, -6.46])
- H6: not supported - Deleting dead companies inflates EW more than momentum and low-volatility (E0 prediction) (bias at 100% deletion: EW +2.32, momentum +2.52, low-vol +1.11 pp/yr)

## Gross -> after costs -> after tax (full primary sample, Rs 10 lakh)

- same-universe EW: 12.5% -> 11.7% -> 11.4% (turnover 5%/month)
- H1 momentum12_top10: 26.7% -> 23.9% -> 21.9% (turnover 28%/month)
- H4 low_vol12_top10: 12.9% -> 12.0% -> 11.1% (turnover 12%/month)
- H5 reversal_top10: 5.5% -> -3.1% -> -3.1% (turnover 90%/month)

## Data-shortcut bias (pp/yr of CAGR)

- survivors: EW +2.60, momentum +3.89, low-vol +1.30
- today's top 500 backwards: EW +11.18, momentum +21.71, low-vol +4.63
- all distressed exits deleted: EW +2.32, momentum +2.52, low-vol +1.11

## Synthetic prediction (E0, 100% of bankrupt firms deleted)

- equal_weight: +3.88 pp/yr
- momentum: +2.53 pp/yr
- low_vol: +1.77 pp/yr
